Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor star in The End of Oak Street, a mysterious sci-fi survival thriller from David Robert Mitchell and producer J.J. Abrams. After a cosmic event rips an entire suburban neighborhood from the world they know, the Platt family must fight to survive in a dangerous new landscape filled with prehistoric terror.

The End of Oak Street arrives in theaters and IMAX August 14, 2026.
